pages.text: $(l)inspect <target> [full]$() — state in chat.$(br)$(l)heal <targets> [part]$() — heal.$(br)$(l)revive <targets>$() — revive.$(br)$(l)kill <targets>$() — death.$(br)$(l)skill <player> <0–10|reset>$() — Medicine level.

$(l)injure <targets> <type> <part> <severity>$() — inflict a wound (cut, stab, gunshot, shrapnel, bruise, burn...). $(l)amputate / restore <targets> <part>$() — remove or restore a limb. $(l)set <targets> <param> <value>$() — blood, SpO₂, consciousness, temperature, organs, tolerance, nutrients, bullets...

$(l)time add <players> <time> [offline]$() — fast-forward treatment time (healing, tourniquet, necrosis, sepsis). $(l)food add <players> <time>$() — fast-forward hunger and thirst. $(l)bed <targets> <x y z>$() — put on a bed. $(l)card <player> <field> <value>$() — a medical record field. $(l)stats [hours] / stats history <player>$() — the log. $(l)panel$() — the GM panel.
